title: Crispy Double Smash Burger
hook: The smash burger that beats takeout

shots.visual_prompt: Hero close-up of a finished double smash burger on a wooden board: two thin beef patties with lacy, deeply browned crispy edges, melted American cheese dripping down the sides, diced white onion, pickle chips, glossy burger sauce, toasted potato bun, a wisp of steam. Chef Whiskers leans in from the side of the frame, eyes wide and sparkling, licking its lips. Slow push-in.

Medium close-up: Chef Whiskers stands on a small wooden step stool at the counter, finely dicing half a white onion with a chef's knife on a wooden cutting board in quick, careful chops. Its eyes squint and water comically from the onion. The onion pieces are glistening and hyper-realistic.
shots.on_screen_text: Dice half an onion super fine

shots.visual_prompt: Close-up on a ripping-hot black cast-iron skillet with light smoke. Chef Whiskers sets a loose ball of ground beef in the pan and immediately presses it flat with a sturdy metal spatula, pushing down with both paws. Fat sizzles and spits, the edges spread thin and lacy and start to brown.

Macro close-up in the skillet: a slice of American cheese drapes over the flipped, deeply browned crispy patty and slowly melts, cascading over the edges, steam rising. Chef Whiskers watches in awe in the soft-focus background, the warm glow reflected in its eyes.

Chef Whiskers stacks two cheesy patties onto a sauced, toasted potato bun with onion and pickles, presses the top bun down, then lifts the burger with both paws and takes a big happy bite, eyes closing in delight, cheese stretching, a crumb on its whiskers. Warm golden light, gentle slow motion.

caption:
10-minute double smash burgers with crispy, lacy edges 🍔🐾

Makes 2 burgers
• 1 lb (450 g) 80/20 ground beef, rolled into 4 loose balls
• Kosher salt and black pepper
• 4 slices American cheese
• ½ small white onion, finely diced
• Pickle chips
• 2 potato buns, buttered and toasted
• Sauce: 3 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp ketchup, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 1 tbsp chopped pickles

1. Heat a cast-iron skillet over high heat until it just starts to smoke.
2. Add 2 beef balls and smash them flat with a sturdy spatula right away. Hold 10 seconds, then season with salt and pepper.
3. Cook about 2 minutes, until the edges are deep brown. Scrape under the crust and flip.
4. Add a slice of cheese to each and cook 1 more minute, until melted and cooked through (160°F / 71°C). Repeat with the rest of the beef.
5. Spread sauce on the buns, then stack 2 patties, onion and pickles. Eat right away.

Chef Whiskers is an animated character. The recipe is real, so go make it!
